name: rippling wall
description: This stretch of wallpaper moves.  Not much, just a slow ripple, like a curtain in a draft, though the air here is perfectly still.  When you look straight at it, it stops.  Examine it to step through.

name: rippling concrete
description: A patch of concrete wall that sways like a hanging sheet.  Through it, faintly, you can hear fluorescent lights humming.  Examine it to step through.

name: lit concrete floor
description: Concrete under a single working light.  There's a faint outline on the floor here, roughly the shape of a person, where the dust hasn't settled.
